title: Солнечные поля
palette: Golden yellow fields, fresh light green grass, barn red, rich brown soil, muted sky-blue fountain water and warm tan earth. No dark cypresses or white domes.
terrain: A wide asymmetric farm plateau with shallow diagonal agricultural terraces and rounded loess cliffs with thick grass-root edges. Open fields occupy much more area than buildings.
landmarks: One small off-center red timber barn, two chunky sunflower field patches, a low broad stone fountain, a shallow duckless pond and a few apple trees. Large simple crop masses rather than thousands of tiny flowers.
road: Broad ochre farm lane with gentle wheel-worn relief and short brick-paved courtyard segment; no stairs or continuous circular curb.
journey: Wind between sunflower patches, sweep through the inner fountain courtyard, curve beside the pond, cut across an open middle meadow, then bend toward the barn-side exit. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Sunny stylized farmland with broad friendly forms, matte painted timber and open readable terrain.
architecture: Keep SOUTHEAST red barn, make it a courier/radio workshop with one chunky brass vent and short antenna. Add a low red-timber radio home on NORTHWEST wheat terrace and a squat wooden windmill with brass hub on outer WEST/SOUTHWEST field shoulder. Fountain/pond and sunflower masses remain. Three readable silhouettes, not a central tower.
